title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Ipswich (Hybrid Working Available)
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000
Hours: Monday to Friday, Full-Time

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented HR Administrator to join a growing HR team. This role will play a key part in delivering a seamless employee experience by providing efficient HR administration, supporting HR systems, maintaining data accuracy, and assisting with a variety of people-focused processes across the employee lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional looking to further develop their career within a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide HR administration across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes and offboarding.
- Produce contracts, offer letters and other employment-related documentation.
- Coordinate onboarding activities and ensure new starters have the equipment, system access and support they need.
- Maintain accurate employee records and update HR systems in a timely manner.
- Support payroll and benefits administration, ensuring information is accurate and submitted on time.
- Respond to employee and manager queries, providing guidance on HR policies and procedures.
- Produce HR reports and assist with data analysis, audits and compliance checks.
- Ensure all HR records and processes remain compliant with company policies, GDPR and employment legislation.
- Support HR projects, process improvements and initiatives aimed at enhancing the employee experience.
- Build strong working relationships with employees, managers and key stakeholders across the business.

About You
- Previous experience in a HR support, HR coordination or HR operations environment.
- Sound knowledge of HR procedures and the employee journey from onboarding through to leaving.
- Highly organised with a strong eye for detail and accuracy.
- Able to manage a busy workload, prioritise tasks and work to deadlines.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Awareness of UK employment law and data protection requirements.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification, or currently studying towards a higher CIPD level, would be beneficial.
- Experience working with HR platforms and databases; exposure to Workday would be an advantage.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000
- Hybrid working available
- Monday to Friday working pattern
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Excellent opportunity for development and career progression within HR operations and employee experience.

If you are interested in this role, please apply with your up-to-date CV or contact Rachel Dunham at Reed Ipswich for more information.

title: Public Realm Administrator
company: Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils are looking for a Public Realm Administrator to join our team. You will join us on a part time, fixed term or secondment opportunity for 12 months, working 18.5 hours per week. The successful candidate will earn a competitive salary of £28,608 - £32,046 per annum pro rata.

Join our team

We are looking for an Administrator (Admin and Technical Support Officer) to join our Public Realm team.

If you share our values and you are motivated to make a difference for our residents, clients, and communities, we would love to hear from you.

About the role

This is predominantly a support role for the Operational Teams, answering queries as first point of contact, transferring or signposting the customer to colleagues or external sources where appropriate. This may be by telephone, e-mail or through our workflow software system.

You will also be raising requisitions via the finance system and progressing through to payments, speaking with suppliers and other teams when needed as well as other general administration duties.

About you

We are looking for a flexible team player who is organised and able to multi-task and work at pace.

Attention to detail will be key and there is a need for experience in using Microsoft Office including the ability to use Word, Outlook and Excel.

You will have good communication skills; both written and verbal.

About us

At Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils we are passionate about building communities that people want to live, work, visit and invest in.

We serve around 200,000 residents across our two districts and are well known for our collaboration and partnership working across public, private and voluntary sectors.

We believe that the heart of Suffolk is an incredibly special place to live and work, with:
- 60 conservation areas
- two National Landscapes
- many picturesque market towns

It is no surprise we are ranked among the top 50 places to live in the UK (United Kingdom).

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
- Generous leave entitlement (26 days a year, rising to 31 days after 5 years).
- Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance Programs.
- Private Health Care Options.
- Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
- Paid volunteering days.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements (Business needs permitting).
- Great learning and development opportunities.

Our ways of working

We believe work is what we do, not just where we go.

We work in a hybrid way, with a mix of office, home, and remote based working (Business need permitting). Our hybrid working arrangements support flexibility and collaboration, helping our teams to thrive.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, providing opportunity and ambition for all, supporting and enabling our people to deliver the best possible services for our residents.

Closing date: 5pm, 17 September 2026

If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this Public Ream Administrator role, even if you don t meet all the requirements, please apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

This authority is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. DBS checks or police vetting will be required for relevant posts.

title: Operations Co-ordinator
description:
Operations Co-ordinator
Lowestoft, Suffolk (Fully Site-Based)
6-Month Contract (until 20/03/2027)
Inside IR35: 17.00 per hour PAYE or 21.81 per hour Umbrella
Overtime: 150%

Belcan Workforce Solutions is recruiting for an Operations Co-ordinator to support a major offshore wind operations site in Lowestoft, Suffolk. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-paced renewable energy environment, playing a key role in ensuring the smooth coordination of maintenance activities, operational planning, and site administration. This position is fully site-based. Due to the operational requirements of the role, candidates should ideally be based within approximately 30 minutes of the Lowestoft site.

Working within a busy operational team, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate technical and commercial records, coordinating planned and reactive maintenance activities, and supporting site operations through SAP and associated systems. You will liaise closely with field personnel and operational stakeholders to optimise schedules, resource allocation, and Crew Transfer Vessel (CTV) deployment. The role also includes supporting reporting, parts consumption tracking, timesheet verification, billing processes, and ensuring all work is completed in line with HSE requirements and UK legislation.

The successful Operations Co-ordinator will be highly organised, detail-focused, and confident working with multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Strong Excel and general IT skills are essential, while SAP experience would be advantageous but is not required. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams are key to success in this role.

Key Requirements & Benefits
- Fully site-based role in Lowestoft, Suffolk
- 7 days on / 7 days off shift pattern working 12-hour days
- Initial 4-week training period worked Monday to Friday
- Competitive rates of 17.00 per hour PAYE or 21.81 per hour Umbrella, plus 150% overtime

Apply now for this Operations Co-ordinator opportunity and take the next step in your career within the renewable energy sector.

This vacancy is being advertised by Belcan

title: Administrator
description: We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and flexible Administrator, to join our fantastic team at Howard House Surgery in Felixstowe,with the primary focus on the role within Secretarial administration and prescriptions administration supporting with referrals and prescription requests. We are part of Suffolk Primary Care, which is a group of GP practices delivering patient care across Suffolk. The vacancy is for 3 days a week; however, this may be negotiable for the right candidate. Flexibility is crucial to accommodate training, holidays and occasional sickness. Howard House Surgery supports in excess of 8500 patients from a diverse range of backgrounds. We have an established team with a strong focus on customer service and on developing staff in order to deliver excellent standards of patient care. We use SystmOne and askmyGP to facilitate effective and efficient ways of working. You should be able to work calmly and professionally as part of a team, with the ability to multi-task. A strong command of written and spoken English with an excellent telephone manner is a must. Good time management skills and the ability to follow protocols and or instruction and attention to detail is essential. We offer a competitive salary along with other employee benefits, and the opportunity to join the NHS pension scheme. The main responsibilities of the post holder will be to ensure timely, accurate and consistent completions of referrals to secondary care, as well as accurately completing prescription requests and sending these to the appropriate pharmacy's. Working as part of a team, the post holder will be responsible for working closely with clinicians to gain the appropriate information to complete referrals and ensuring repeat medications are kept up to date and safely prescribed. They are accountable to the Administration Lead and Practice Operations Manager.
